document.abstract: The organization of the Training Film Branch and the scope of its job are indicated. Problems encountered in the production of the Navy's training films are considered. Special emphasis is given to research, pre-planning of production and script writing. The difficulties that result from undertaking an extensive training-film production program under wartime conditions are presented briefly.
